assessment: Haimen Natural Resources and Planning Bureau and the official Haimen real-estate registration service are evidenced local registry/cadastral custodians. Official material also documents cadastral-survey database construction and provincial data submission, but no current safe anonymous parcel vector response, native identity, CRS, or geometry was qualified.
